content_encoding: UTF-8 JSON; sort_keys=true; separators=comma-colon; ensure_ascii=true; allow_nan=false; SHA256 of these bytes
legacy_encoding: UTF-8 json.dumps of explicit q then p mapping; default separators; ensure_ascii=true; SHA256; existing initial_sha256 meaning unchanged
ordered_arrays: all atom and coordinate arrays preserved; exact finite numeric strings; no numeric conversion or string normalization
duplicates: reject at every JSON object level
live_versions: session and record explicitly V2; missing, downgrade, unknown or changed protocol refused
legacy_access: only pinned France historical review with original ZIP, raw manifest, session/source/replay/failure pins; no live fallback
lightweight: save exclusive original; immediately read bytes and strict JSON; compare entire memory record and saved data; independently check explicit fingerprints and request/plan/start; no physics
stop: first failed saved record raises before replayer or next service call; preserve original and exclusive rejection
deep: existing inspector reads originals, rederives state and all results/costs; existing single inspector identity; shared serialization spec only; no producer attestation accepted
correction: inspector signs FORMAT_EQUIVALENT/VERIFIED_CONTENT metadata only; separate derived certificate refers to raw originals; existing manager verifies inspector, certificate and original hashes; signed explicit review approval retains LEGACY; no new cost profile activation
historical_scope: HISTORICAL_REVIEW_ONLY; original REAL_LEARNING_FAIL unchanged; no learned request or rollback fabricated; no automatic cross-session use
replay_reuse: only already bound same-session original replay in historical review or current runner session; raw/source/state/N/T/p/env binding required; cross-session cache disabled
overhead_metric: fingerprints plus exclusive save/fsync plus strict reread plus lightweight compare; record maximum across five iterations <= original record wall_ns/100; separate components and traced peak/RSS delta/bytes reported
overhead_reference: each pinned France candidate wall_ns, descriptive benchmark reference only; not official verified performance knowledge
limits: same UID not OS authority isolation
